name: Mimi
source: Having given up on college, Mimi has become a kogyaru, a young girl with tanned skin and dyed hair, in order to enjoy her last days as a school student. However, her spoiled personality has not changed. Despite her appearance, she is still single, chasing the person she fell in love with when she was in her first year of high school.
